##### Project general facts

Al Hamra Greens is a nature-led residential community of mid- and high-rise buildings surrounded by greenery. The architecture embraces simplicity, with clean lines, calm spaces and a palette of soft whites, quiet browns, warm woods and touches of green that blend seamlessly with the outdoors. Native trees, blooming corners and shaded courtyards run through the masterplan. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with the larger homes including a maid's room, for individuals, couples and families.

Amenities are shaped around nature, wellness and community life. Residents can enjoy resort-style pools, a gym with a view, a padel court and a basketball court, together with a continuous jogging and cycling loop that winds through landscaped green spaces. Families benefit from a kids' play area and a gaming arcade, while a barbecue terrace and a pet-friendly park create relaxed places for neighbours to meet. Quiet gardens and shaded nooks offer calm corners for reading and rest.

Interiors are designed to bring the outdoors in, with floor-to-ceiling windows that welcome golden daylight and frame views of the surrounding greenery and golf course. Living and dining areas flow onto balconies, some designed for herb gardens, while bedrooms include dressing areas and selected layouts add a powder room and a laundry or storage room. Kitchens are fitted with appliances, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Hamra Village is the first fully integrated master community of Ras Al Khaimah, stretching along the coast with pristine beaches, interconnected lagoons and lush landscaping. It brings together a championship golf course, the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, Al Hamra Marina and Al Hamra Mall, alongside five-star resorts such as Waldorf Astoria, The Ritz-Carlton Al Hamra Beach and Sofitel Al Hamra Beach.

RAK Central, the emirate's live-work-play district with offices, retail and pedestrian boulevards, lies just across the road. Al Marjan Island and the Wynn Al Marjan Island resort are a short drive away, while Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects the community with Dubai and Dubai International Airport, while the mountains of Jebel Jais offer outdoor adventures within reach.

Al Hamra Village is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most established communities in Ras Al Khaimah. The rapid growth of tourism and hospitality around Al Marjan Island supports strong rental demand from both residents and holiday guests. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with a mature lifestyle offer, make the area attractive to end users and investors alike.
